persona.title: Pretend you are…
persona.text: Pretend you are Brian, 19, who finished Form Four in Eldoret last year and now helps at his uncle's shop. He dreams of becoming an electrician, but he does not know where to start, and the dream feels very far away. Today he wants a clear picture of his future and one small step he can take this month.

lines: Welcome. This short video explains an app called Daraja Compass. In about four minutes you will know what it is for and how to use it.

First, the problem. Many young people have a dream. My own shop. A trade. A good job. A house. But the dream feels far away, and nobody shows them the first step. So the years pass and the dream stays a dream.

Compass helps you turn a dream into a plan. You answer fifteen simple questions about yourself and your future. Then the app writes a picture of your life five years from now, in your own words. Then it helps you walk backward from that dream to one small step you can do this month.
Who uses it? Young people finishing school, students, anyone starting again. It was made with young Kenyans in mind, so the examples talk about matatus, shops and shillings.

lines.t: At the top is the name, Daraja Compass. Under it, a gold box says what the app is for.
The first card asks: Where are you going? There is a Bible verse that changes every day.
Tap the button Start my Compass to begin.

lines: Now the questions come one at a time. At the top it says Question 1 of 15, and a gold bar fills up as you go.
The first questions are easy: your name, and your age. Type in the box and tap Next.
Many questions have example answers you can tap, like My own small shop, or A trade, electrician, tailor, mechanic. Tap one and it goes into the box. Then change the words so they fit you.
Some questions are just a choice, like Marriage in five years: Yes, Maybe, or Not in 5 years. Tap one. No typing.
Question seven asks what work you see yourself doing in five years. Question eight asks what monthly income would make that life possible. Type a number and the money, like KES 40,000.
You can skip any question. There are no wrong answers. The button Back goes to the question before.
On the last question the button says Paint my picture. Compass then writes your five-year picture: your work, your money, your home, your faith, and how you help others.
If it is not right, tap Change answers. If it is the life you want, tap Yes, build my path.
Now comes the clever part. Compass walks backward from the dream. For each goal, there are lines with a time in gold: 5 years, 3 years, 2 years, 1 year, 6 months, and This month.
On each line you write what must be true by then. For example, to be an electrician in five years, maybe in one year you must finish the course.
The last line, This month, is the most important. It is one small step you can do in the next few weeks. Visit a college. Ask a question. Save the first shillings.
Then tap Save my path, my Compass. You arrive at your Compass home.
At the top it counts Goals met. Under that, the card called This month shows your small steps. When you finish one, tap the box next to it. It turns green with a tick and you get a star.
Everything saves on this phone. Nothing is sent anywhere. To erase it all, scroll to the very bottom and tap Start fresh.
In the test, you will be Brian, a young man in Eldoret who dreams of becoming an electrician. Take your time, and tell us anything that confuses you.

challenge.intro: Now you are Brian. Compass is empty. Nobody will tell you which button to press. Use what you learned. When you finish, tap Check my work.
challenge.start: Open Daraja Compass with the normal app link (not the 🧪 test copy). If the welcome tour shows, tap 'skip the tour' → '✨ Start fresh with my own' → OK. If it does not show, scroll to the very bottom of the page and tap '🧹 Start fresh — erase this app’s data' → OK → OK (if it says there is nothing to erase, just tap OK). You should see the card 'Where are you going?' with the button 'Start my Compass →'. (Verified 10 Oct: all five checks false after this.)

tasks.text: Tell Compass who you are: Brian, 19 years old.
tasks.check: (function(){try{var d=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('daraja_compass_v1')||'null');if(!d||d.ex)return false;var a=d.a||{};var low=function(s){return String(s==null?'':s).trim().toLowerCase()};var gs=d.goals||[];var W=gs.filter(function(g){return String(g.t||'').indexOf('\ud83d\udcbc')===0});var rung=function(w){var o=[];W.forEach(function(g){(g.r||[]).forEach(function(r){if(r.w===w)o.push(r)})});return o};return low(a.name).indexOf('brian')>=0&&Number(a.age)===19}catch(e){return false}})()
tasks.hint: Tap 'Start my Compass →'. The first two questions ask your name and your age.

tasks.text: Your five-year dream: working as an electrician and earning KES 40,000 a month.
tasks.check: (function(){try{var d=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('daraja_compass_v1')||'null');if(!d||d.ex)return false;var a=d.a||{};var low=function(s){return String(s==null?'':s).trim().toLowerCase()};var gs=d.goals||[];var W=gs.filter(function(g){return String(g.t||'').indexOf('\ud83d\udcbc')===0});var rung=function(w){var o=[];W.forEach(function(g){(g.r||[]).forEach(function(r){if(r.w===w)o.push(r)})});return o};return low(a.work).indexOf('electric')>=0&&String(a.income||'').replace(/[^0-9]/g,'')==='40000'}catch(e){return false}})()
tasks.hint: Question 7 asks about your work in five years, and question 8 asks about monthly income. Write the number in full, like KES 40,000.

tasks.text: Build your path. For your work goal, write what must be true in 1 year: you have finished the electrician course.
tasks.check: (function(){try{var d=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('daraja_compass_v1')||'null');if(!d||d.ex)return false;var a=d.a||{};var low=function(s){return String(s==null?'':s).trim().toLowerCase()};var gs=d.goals||[];var W=gs.filter(function(g){return String(g.t||'').indexOf('\ud83d\udcbc')===0});var rung=function(w){var o=[];W.forEach(function(g){(g.r||[]).forEach(function(r){if(r.w===w)o.push(r)})});return o};return rung('1 year').some(function(r){return low(r.t).indexOf('course')>=0})}catch(e){return false}})()
tasks.hint: After the last question, tap 'Paint my picture →' and then 'Yes — build my path →'. On the 💼 work card, find the line marked 1 year.

tasks.text: On the same work goal, write ONE small step for this month: visit the technical college to ask about the course.
tasks.check: (function(){try{var d=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('daraja_compass_v1')||'null');if(!d||d.ex)return false;var a=d.a||{};var low=function(s){return String(s==null?'':s).trim().toLowerCase()};var gs=d.goals||[];var W=gs.filter(function(g){return String(g.t||'').indexOf('\ud83d\udcbc')===0});var rung=function(w){var o=[];W.forEach(function(g){(g.r||[]).forEach(function(r){if(r.w===w)o.push(r)})});return o};return rung('This month').some(function(r){return low(r.t).indexOf('college')>=0})}catch(e){return false}})()
tasks.hint: On your path, the 💼 work card has a line marked 'This month' at the bottom. 🗺 My path on the Compass home opens it again.

tasks.text: You visited the college yesterday. Show on your Compass home that this month's work step is done.
tasks.check: (function(){try{var d=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('daraja_compass_v1')||'null');if(!d||d.ex)return false;var a=d.a||{};var low=function(s){return String(s==null?'':s).trim().toLowerCase()};var gs=d.goals||[];var W=gs.filter(function(g){return String(g.t||'').indexOf('\ud83d\udcbc')===0});var rung=function(w){var o=[];W.forEach(function(g){(g.r||[]).forEach(function(r){if(r.w===w)o.push(r)})});return o};return rung('This month').some(function(r){return low(r.t).indexOf('college')>=0&&r.done===true})}catch(e){return false}})()
tasks.hint: Tap 'Save my path → my Compass'. On the home screen, the card 'This month' has a box next to each step.

ownWords.question: In your own words, what is this app for?
keyIdeas: helps you picture your life five years from now
walks backward from the dream to smaller goals
ends with one small step to do this month, and you tick it when done

daily.task: Change or add one step on your path in Daraja Compass — or tick one step done.
